returnPolicy.title: Return & Refund Policy
returnPolicy.cardDesc: When and how you can return an order, and how refunds work.
returnPolicy.highlightText: If an item arrives damaged, broken, spoiled, wrong or not as described, request a return with photos within 12 hours of delivery.
returnPolicy.modalSubtitle: For orders placed on the Sribees Online app and website.
returnPolicy.banner: Every return request is checked by the branch manager of the branch that delivered your order. The final decision to approve a return belongs to the branch manager.

sections.title: When you can return
points: You can request a return within 12 hours of your order being delivered. Your order shows how much time is left.
After 12 hours the return option closes. If you still need help, contact us through Help & Support or at support@sribeesonline.com.
Only one return request can be made for each order, so select every item you want to return at the same time.

sections.title: What you can return
points: Items that arrived damaged, broken, leaking or faulty.
Items that arrived spoiled or past their expiry date.
A wrong item, or an item that is not as described.
Items whose quality is not acceptable.
You can return the whole parcel, or only some items and quantities.

sections.title: What you cannot return
points: Products marked "Non-returnable" on the product page and in your order. Other items in the same order can still be returned.
Items with nothing wrong that you simply no longer want may not be approved.

sections.title: How to request a return
points: Open your order history, open the delivered order and tap "Return Items".
Choose the items and quantities, then choose a reason. If you choose "Other", tell us briefly what happened.
Add 1 to 4 clear photos that show the problem (JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each). Photos are required, because the branch decides by looking at them.
Submit the request. Your order will show "Return Requested" and you will be notified of the decision.

sections.title: Who decides
points: The branch manager reviews your photos and details. Approving or rejecting a return is the branch manager's final decision.
When approving, the branch manager also decides whether the item needs to be collected from you.
If your request is rejected, the reason is shown on your order.

sections.title: If the item is collected
points: A rider comes to your delivery address to collect the item. Please keep it ready, with its packaging.
Your refund is credited to your Sribees Wallet once the item reaches the branch.

sections.title: If the item is not collected
points: For items that are spoiled or broken and not worth sending back, the branch may refund you without collecting them.
In that case the refund is credited to your Sribees Wallet as soon as the return is approved.

sections.title: Your refund
points: You get back what you paid for the returned items. If you used a coupon, the part of the discount that applied to those items is deducted.
Delivery charges are not refunded.
If a return pickup charge applies, it is shown on the return screen before you submit. It is charged only when a rider collects the item, and never more than your refund.
Cash Back earned on the returned items is removed from your rewards.
Refunds are added to your Sribees Wallet, and you can use them on your next order.
